name: Atlassian Rovo
description: Search, create, and update Jira issues, Confluence pages, and Jira Service Management tickets, and read, commit to, and open pull requests on Bitbucket repos - all through Atlassian's official hosted MCP server, powered by your Teamwork Graph.
notes: API token authentication is preferred here for non-interactive use: provide the Atlassian account email and a personal API token created for Atlassian MCP 2, and the client composes HTTP Basic authentication. Organization administrators must enable API token authentication. OAuth 2.1 remains available and is Atlassian's recommended option for interactive, user-driven scenarios. This is Atlassian MCP v2, which lists its most-used tools directly and the rest through its discover and execute tools; it is also the MCP server for Bitbucket Cloud.
installHint: Prefer the API token option for non-interactive use. Create a scoped personal API token for Atlassian MCP 2, then enter the owning Atlassian account email and token separately; the client composes Authorization: Basic base64(email:token). Atlassian Rovo is hosted for Atlassian Cloud and does not connect to Jira, Confluence, or Bitbucket Data Center.

username.label: Atlassian account email
username.helperText: Use the email address of the Atlassian account that owns the API token.

password.label: Atlassian API token
password.helperText: Create a scoped token for Atlassian MCP 2 on the [preconfigured token creation page](https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens?autofillToken&expiryDays=max&appId=mcp-v2&selectedScopes=all), and review the [official API-token authentication guide](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/rovo-mcp/guides/configuring-authentication-via-api-token/).
